title: Celebration of Liberation
description:
Juneteenth Town Hall Meeting: Celebration Of Liberation

Juneteenth was initially a commemoration of ending slavery in the United States at the end of the Civil War on June 19th, 1865. description:

Title: Of the People, By the People, For the People- Protest March and Rally

Theme: Attack Our Problems, Embrace Our Neighbors

Diversity makes our nation stronger! Division is our weakness, and the Mega Rich Oligarchs know it. Join us, the 99%, to condemn federal attacks on and show our appreciation for foreign students, immigrants, the LGBTQIA+ community, Native Americans, Black Americans, Latino Americans, Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders, working poor, homeless, those on disability, veterans, the elderly, federal workers and more. The time to speak up is NOW!!! No more parties, no more politics, no kings. The time to stand up is NOW! Someone you care about is already affected. Who will be next?

Where and When:
March Route- Meet at 3:30 pm on either side of the old Flathead County Courthouse (800 S Main St, Kalispell). Rally at Depot Park @4-5:30 pm.

We will proceed along both sides of Main Street to Depot Park. We’ll be walking on the sidewalks so please make sure there’s a space for people who aren’t protesting to pass. We also need to follow all traffic laws, no blocking traffic, obeying crosswalk lights, and staying on the sidewalk.

If you can’t walk from the courthouse, there will be a crew at Depot Park for the duration of the event so plan to stay there.

Rally Details- The rally ends at Depot Park in Kalispell! This is where we’ll have speakers, music, and food (more on that later) from 4-5:30 pm. After the rally, you can stay and visit or walk back to the courthouse at your leisure.

Safety notes: There will likely be a few counter protesters, although we’ve taken steps to minimize this risk. Please just ignore them. There will be a few folks on hand to help deescalate potential conflicts but since there will be so many of us, it’s helpful if we commit to supporting one another and NOT engaging with trolls.

We’ll be in Depot Park so do your best to tread lightly on the grass and to clean up. This is our chance to demonstrate that we’re a respectful and upstanding group–neighbors and friends who are standing up for our country.

Parking and bathrooms: There’s parking on the east and west sides of the old courthouse and in the surrounding neighborhoods. If you’re meeting at Depot Park, you can park at the Mall or the Super 1. Please only park in the Depot Park parking lot if you are elderly or disabled.

Depot Park bathrooms will be available!

Food: We will have a drink and food table with “Resistance Swag” and voter registration at Depot Park. If you would like to donate drinks, side dishes or desserts, please drop them off at Depot Park at 3:00 pm. If you know any businesses that might want to donate and you can reach out and coordinate we’d appreciate it! Thanks in advance!

These notes are also important!

Email flatheaddemocracy@gmail.com with questions or if you're interested in volunteering for logistics or donating food/supplies!

Bring cash! We’ll have a table setup for some swag and appreciate donations to cover printing costs, as well as the event permit and sound system. We’re going old school on this one and will have a donation jar. Even a couple bucks helps cover costs.

Please bring a poster (or more!) sharing what group of people you are most passionate about protecting or how diversity makes us stronger. We will have some poster making materials at the beginning if you can’t, but they will be limited. If you have extra materials to share that’s helpful too!

Wear red, white, and blue to demonstrate solidarity. This isn’t a must but it makes for a really impressive visual!

Thank you for reading all this to help us prepare together and get pumped! We are making history together ✊🏽

Best, The Whole Flathead Democracy Team

title: Fri. 6/6 > Mass Pike Overpass Standout in Westfield - Southampton Rd (Routes 10/202)
description:
Wow! What a great location for a standout! On 5/30, around 17 people, including a bagpiper!  What a blast! LOTS of engagement with motorists!

There's lots and lots of traffic passing by. Southampton Road (Routes 10/202) is heavily traveled northbound and southbound, and the Mass Pike eastbound and westbound is below. Lots of honks and thumbs up and waves...and a few folks flying middle fingers. We smile and wave at them all! 

We'll have letterboards prepared for the lower part of the overpass fencing - the photo shows how that will look to folks passing on the Mass Pike. We're interacting with motorists on the Mass Pike, and on Southampton Road. We've discovered that the magic happens when we smile and wave to people!

Come when you can, and leave when you must. You needn't be present for the entire 1 1/2 hours.

### How to Get There

The address "130 Southampton Road, Westfield" will get you just north of the overpass. 

### Parking

We can't park in the Southampton Rd breakdown lane. There are vacant business properties north of the bridge, and it seems that parking would be OK there.

It looks like The Wealth Technology Group has vacated their office at 130 Southampton Rd, but the internet says that other businesses are located there, so please be mindful if you decide to park there.

### Etiquette!

We don't give the finger to people who give the finger to us, or who say unpleasant things. We smile and wave to them, too. 

We may see a counter protester. If so, the best thing to do is just ignore them and spend our time and energy waving to motorists. Let's keep things 100% non-confrontational in words and body language.

### Other Stuff

Please take everything you brought away with you, and leave the site totally clean.

If rain is predicted, we'll cancel. If we cancel, you'll receive an email notification.

### A Few Requests

We've found that roof rake sections make wonderful flagpoles and banner poles. If you have a roof rake (or 10’-15’ light metal poles or conduit) to contribute, we'll be happy to take it off your hands!

And, if you have an extra 3' x 5' American flag you're not using, we'd love it if you'd pass it on to us!
